SpringTransitionModel.luau.description: Spring Transition Model provides the class/model implementation used by the Transitionmodel package.

TimedTransitionModel.luau.description: A BasicPane transition driven by a linear `TimedTween`. Public entry points include `TimedTransitionModel.new`, `TimedTransitionModel.SetTransitionTime`, `TimedTransitionModel.IsShowingComplete`, `TimedTransitionModel.IsHidingComplete`, `TimedTransitionModel.ObserveIsShowingComplete`, `TimedTransitionModel.ObserveIsHidingComplete`, `TimedTransitionModel.BindToPaneVisbility`,…

TransitionModel.luau.description: This model deduplicates and handles transitions for showing, hiding, and toggling. Inherits from [BasicPane]. See for more API. Public entry points include `TransitionModel.new`, `TransitionModel.isTransitionModel`, `TransitionModel.PromiseShow`, `TransitionModel.PromiseHide`, `TransitionModel.PromiseToggle`, `TransitionModel.IsShowingComplete`, `TransitionModel.IsHidingComplete`,…
